When a parking permit runs out, the office follows these steps:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    a["Permit end date passes"] --> b{"Renewed?" :::focus}
    b -- "Yes" --> c["Nothing to do"]
    b -- "No" --> d["Calculate late fee"]
    d --> e["Send reminder letter"]
    e --> f{"Fee paid?"}
    f -- "Yes" --> g["Permit restored"]
    f -- "No" --> h["Suspend the permit"]
    h --> i["Hand to enforcement"]
    g --> j["File the case"]
    c --> j
```

A paid fee restores the permit the same day.
